summary: Loop that calls ShortComputation_8e00 on each of 1024 successive 6-DWORD-strided slots of the buffer starting at 0x008C5F48, then returns the last call's result.

operations.description: Set the walking pointer v0 to the start of the buffer at 0x008C5F48 (global unk_8C5F48).
Initialize the loop counter v1 to 1024 iterations.
Do-while loop executing exactly 1024 times, terminating when the counter reaches zero.
Call ShortComputation_8e00 with the current pointer v0 as argument each iteration.
Advance the walking pointer v0 by 6 DWORDs (24 bytes) per iteration, implying a fixed 24-byte record stride over the buffer.
Decrement the loop counter v1 by 1 each iteration.
Return the result of the final ShortComputation_8e00 call.

unresolved: Purpose of the buffer at 0x008C5F48 and the exact semantics of ShortComputation_8e00 are unknown; the 6-DWORD stride implies a 24-byte record but its layout is unconfirmed.
Why only the last call's result is returned is unexplained by the evidence.
